# Wise Women Use AI

Practical AI and business systems for women running their own businesses, with Gen X women at its heart. Founded by Kelly Hartley in Melbourne, Australia.

- [Start free](https://www.wisewomenuseai.com/community): AI foundations, Business Dependency Diagnostic, Clear the Decks and First Wins inside the free Skool community.
- [Architect Advantage](https://www.wisewomenuseai.com/architect): Supported DIY implementation, Systems Library, walkthroughs, one monthly member implementation call with replay, and help in Skool. $69 USD per month, billed through Skool. Cancel any time. Software subscriptions are separate.
- [Organisational workshops](https://www.wisewomenuseai.com/work): Practical sessions in Melbourne or online, shaped around a recurring task. Enquire about format and availability.
- [About Kelly](https://www.wisewomenuseai.com/about): Operations experience and the Work That Needs You approach.
- [Worked content example](https://www.wisewomenuseai.com/examples/one-idea-three-drafts): Input, reusable instructions, sample drafts and human checks. No measured time-saving claim.
- [Articles](https://www.wisewomenuseai.com/blog): Practical AI and business systems guidance.
- [Claude, Clearly](https://www.wisewomenuseai.com/guide): Free introductory guide.
- [Claude Starter Kit](https://www.wisewomenuseai.com/starter): Free starter resources.
- [Privacy](https://www.wisewomenuseai.com/privacy)
- [How I use AI](https://www.wisewomenuseai.com/ai-disclosure)

This file is a human-readable summary, not a requirement for search or AI visibility. The public pages are the source of current offer details.
